close_reason: Confirmed correct per RFC 5280; defensive note recorded in issue
description: matches_dns_name correctly implements the RFC 5280 §4.2.1.10 leading-dot semantics: a constraint '.example.com' does NOT match the apex 'example.com' (lines 963-966), only true subdomains. And a constraint without leading dot matches both the apex AND subdomains (lines 973-980). These are distinct rules that contributors often conflate. The apex exclusion guard with the strip_prefix().eq_ignore_ascii_case() check is the right way to implement it. Defend against suggestions to 'simplify' by treating leading-dot identically to no-dot.
title: matches_dns_name apex-exclusion logic is correct per RFC 5280
